findings.description: Shell injection risk via subprocess.Popen with shell=True and user-controlled arguments
findings.code_snippet:
c = subprocess.Popen(
        [str(cmd_path)] + cmd_params,
        shell=True,
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        env=env,
        errors="replace",
        text=True,
    )
findings.reasoning: The code invokes subprocess.Popen with shell=True, passing a command constructed from cmd_path and cmd_params. If either of these are influenced by user input, this allows for arbitrary shell command execution, leading to a high-severity shell injection vulnerability (CWE-78).
